products.name: Grass Cutting Simulator
products.blurb: Cut grass, grow your blade and slice through fruit and trees. 18 levels, 5 blades, boosts.

page.h1: Grass Cutting Simulator: Unity Game Template
page.title: Grass Cutting Simulator: Unity Game Template
page.description: Grass Cutting Simulator is a complete Unity game template: cut grass to grow your blade, slice fruit and trees, beat the clock with boosts and earn three stars across 18 levels.
intro: Grass Cutting Simulator is a complete, ready-to-play Unity game template. Steer a spinning blade across the field: every patch of grass you cut makes the blade grow, and a bigger blade can slice through fruit and even trees. Too small? The game tells you to grow first.
Each of the 18 levels has its own field with flowers, patterns and fences. Speed and time boosts help you beat the clock, and a fast finish earns three stars and a treasure chest.
features: 5 blades, each with 4 sizes, and a blade shop
Grow-as-you-cut mechanic: get bigger to slice fruit and trees
Fields with flowers, patterns and fences

products.name: Arrow Escape
products.blurb: Arrow puzzle game with a level editor, image-to-level generator, 30 levels and endless mode.

page.h1: Arrow Escape: Unity Arrow Puzzle Game Template
page.title: Arrow Escape: Unity Arrow Puzzle Game Template
page.description: Arrow Escape is a complete Unity arrow puzzle game template with a built-in level editor, an image-to-level generator, 30 hand-made levels, endless mode and dark and light themes.
intro: Arrow Escape is a full grid-based arrow puzzle game for Unity. Tap an arrow and it glides off the board if its path is clear, or bounces back if something is in the way. Clear every arrow to win.
It ships with a built-in level editor: turn any pixel art into a level in one click, and every generated level is always solvable. You can also drag any arrow to reshape it by hand.
features: Built-in level editor with automatic and manual generation
Image-to-level generator: any pixel art becomes a level
4 arrow designs: Arrow, Casual Snake, Pattern Snake and Pencil
Dark mode and light mode themes
Automatic camera zoom and responsive grid scaling

products.name: Paper Plane Controller
products.blurb: Arcade paper plane flight controller with 10 plane designs, boost, crashes and a demo map. Unreal + Unity.

page.h1: Paper Plane Controller for Unreal Engine & Unity
page.title: Paper Plane Controller for Unreal Engine & Unity
page.description: Paper Plane Controller is a ready-to-use flight controller for paper plane games in Unreal Engine 5 and Unity, with 10 plane designs, boost, a dynamic camera, crashes and a demo map.
page.compat: On Fab it supports Unreal Engine 5.6 to 5.8 on Windows, macOS and Linux, and the listing also includes a Unity version. The Unity Asset Store listing is coming soon.
intro: Paper Plane Controller gives you smooth, arcade-style paper plane flight out of the box: perfect for casual flying games, obstacle courses and fast-paced aerial gameplay.
It includes 10 paper plane designs, a boost system, a dynamic camera, a crash system and a demo map. The forests and villages in the trailer are for demonstration only and are not included.
features: Game-ready Blueprints (Unreal) and a Unity version

products.name: Dark 2D World: Extended
products.blurb: 250+ prefabs, 236 hand-drawn sprites, interactive water and a 15-minute playable level.

page.h1: Dark 2D World Extended: Limbo-Style 2D Pack for Unity
page.title: Dark 2D World Extended: Limbo-Style Unity Pack
page.description: Dark 2D World Extended is a Limbo-style 2D environment pack for Unity with 250+ prefabs, 236 hand-drawn sprites, interactive water, a character controller and a 15-minute level.
intro: Dark 2D World Extended is the full version of our free Dark 2D World pack: everything you need to build a dark, atmospheric 2D platformer in the style of Limbo.

It adds interactive water with ripples and floating objects, ladders, pushable crates, a character controller and a playable demo level of more than 15 minutes. Want to try the art first? Grab the free Dark 2D World.
features: Interactive water: ripples, floating objects and splashes
Character controller: run, jump, climb ladders, swim
Pushable crates and floating or sinking objects

products.name: Archer Kit
products.blurb: Bow-and-arrow physics, aiming, 5 bows and 5 arrows. A full archery game to reskin.

page.h1: Archer Kit: Unity Archery Game Template
page.title: Archer Kit: Unity Bow & Arrow Game Template
page.description: Unity archery game template with bow-and-arrow physics, aiming and trajectory projection, 5 bows, 5 arrows, explosive hits and FPS movement. Built-in and URP; PC, WebGL and mobile.
intro: Archer Kit gives you a working bow-and-arrow game in Unity. Draw, aim with a projected trajectory, release, and watch arrows fly and land with real physics.
Use it as the starting point for an archery, FPS or survival game, or take the archery system and drop it into a project you already have.
features: 5 custom arrows with different speeds and effects
Runs on PC, WebGL and mobile

products.name: Sling Shooter
products.blurb: Physics slingshot gameplay with stickman combat, 10 levels and AdMob, ready to rebrand.

page.h1: Sling Shooter: Unity Slingshot Game Template
page.title: Sling Shooter: Unity Slingshot Game Template
page.description: Complete Unity slingshot game template with aim, pull and release controls, physics-based stickman combat, 10 demo levels, level editing tools and AdMob. Built-in and URP.
intro: Sling Shooter is a complete physics shooting game for Unity. Aim, pull back and release, then watch stickmen and props fly and bounce with real physics.
On the Unity Asset Store it is listed as Stickman Shooter. It ships with demo levels, level editing tools and AdMob, so you can rebrand it and publish quickly.
features: Aim, pull and release slingshot controls
10 demo levels plus level editing tools
Runs on PC, WebGL and mobile

products.name: Rope Puzzle
products.blurb: Untangle-the-rope puzzle with 40 levels, two game modes and power-ups. Playable demo.

page.h1: Rope Puzzle: Unity Rope Untangle Game Template
page.title: Rope Puzzle: Unity Rope Untangle Game Template
page.description: Unity rope-untangling puzzle game template (Twisted Ropes) with grid-based levels, 40 demo levels, sphere and stickman modes, timer challenges and freeze and cut power-ups.
intro: Rope Puzzle (Twisted Ropes) is a casual untangle-the-rope game for Unity. Levels are built on a grid, so it is easy to design new puzzles and scale the difficulty.
Version 2.0 includes 40 demo levels, two game modes and power-ups. You can try the playable demo on itch.io before you buy.
features: 40 demo levels with a difficulty curve
Runs on PC, WebGL and mobile
Beginner-friendly, easy to modify and extend

page.title: Dark 2D World: Free Limbo-Style 2D Pack for Unity
page.description: Free dark, atmospheric 2D environment pack for Unity: 100+ handcrafted silhouette assets, 3 parallax layers, ambient particles, a player controller, camera and post-processing.
intro: Dark 2D World is a complete kit for haunting, atmospheric 2D platformers in the style of Limbo. It includes silhouette trees, terrain and props, layered backgrounds and moody particles.
It is free on the Unity Asset Store. If you need more, the Extended Version adds a larger set of assets.

Ambient particles: dust and falling leaves

page.h1: Low Poly Fire Particles: Free Unity Campfire VFX
page.title: Free Low Poly Fire Particles for Unity

Code Monkey featured it on YouTube and said he loved how cute it is.

products.name: Fog Particles
products.blurb: Drop-in atmospheric fog and clouds for 2D and 3D games.

page.h1: Fog Particles: Free Unity Fog & Cloud VFX
page.title: Free Fog Particles for Unity: Fog & Cloud VFX
page.description: Free, lightweight fog particle system for Unity. Drag-and-drop prefabs for atmospheric fog or clouds in 2D and 3D games, optimised for mobile, WebGL and PC. Built-in and URP.
intro: Soft, lightweight fog for Unity that you can use as ground fog, mist or clouds. Drag a prefab into your scene and it works straight away.
Density, speed and size are easy to adjust, and it is light enough to use on mobile and WebGL.
features: Use it as fog or as clouds
Made with Unity's built-in Particle System
Optimised for mobile, web and PC
Simple controls for density, speed and size

page.description: Free, performance-friendly rain particle system for Unity with rain streaks, ground splashes and ripples, plus bonus snow. Drag-and-drop prefabs for 2D and 3D, Built-in and URP.
intro: Realistic, performance-friendly rain for Unity, with streaks, ground splashes and ripples. It suits open worlds, horror games and mobile projects.
It also includes a bonus snow effect.
features: Optimised for mobile, web and PC
